method: scripts/verify-audio-reference.mjs generates two tiny original Thumb programs, runs them in locally supplied pinned QEMU v10.1.5-pebble17 and the compiled Rust/Wasm core, and compares the first UART2 byte. No Pebble firmware or app is used.
limits: This independently verifies initial INTSTAT and IRQ 10 delivery only. PCM drain timing, refill backpressure, production firmware scheduling and physical-watch behavior remain unverified.
